input.title: Give the newsletter email input an accessible name that matches its visible label
input.rationale:
The input #news-email has no accessible name. A visible <label>Email address</label> sits just before it (about.html line 11), but that label has no for="news-email" and doesn't wrap the input, so it isn't linked. I can only edit the element at offset 381 (the input), so this patch sets aria-label="Email address". That uses the same words as the visible label, so voice-control users can say what they see.

A better fix for a reviewer to consider: add for="news-email" to the <label> on line 11 and drop the aria-label. That way clicking the label also focuses the input. I can't make that edit because it's outside the target element. This patch fixes the missing name, but it doesn't confirm the page meets any standard.
